meta.project: UAV Red Team Security Testing Platform

product_overview: UAV Red Team is a comprehensive security testing intention orchestration platform designed for UAV red team experts to intuitively organize, monitor in real-time, and fully control security testing processes across UAV ecosystems and web environments, leveraging AI agents and sandbox isolation.
core_goals: Provide intuitive and high-density Kanban style task orchestration for red team security testing intents.
Enable real-time observation of testing agents via VNC, network traffic sniffing, and sandbox monitoring.
Ensure complete control over multi-dimensional security testing across UAV firmware, protocols, and ecosystems.
Support parallel multi-agent development with clear architecture and task decomposition.
key_features: Mission control dashboard with drag-and-drop Kanban board for task management.
Asset management interface featuring UAV/red team assets with topology visualization and risk scoring.
Vulnerability management system tracking CVEs with AI-assisted analysis and PoC generation.
Network scanning capabilities analyzing UAV firmware and network protocols.
Network traffic monitoring with TrafficQL filtering, live capture, and anomaly detection.
Isolated sandbox environment supporting VNC access and operation recording for secure testing.
AI integration for automated agent task execution, result analysis, and scheduling.
Configurable settings panel and workspace with panes and sidebar for flexible UI layout.
Container monitoring UI with real-time resource usage and status visualization.
user_flow_summary: User logs in and selects a mission in the Mission Control dashboard.
User creates and organizes security testing tasks using a Kanban board, assigning priorities and tags.
User monitors ongoing tasks in real-time with embedded VNC views and network traffic analysis.
User reviews vulnerability findings with filtering, detailed CVE information, AI confidence scores, and PoC code.
User manages UAV assets with network topology visualization, risk scores, and device details.
User conducts network scans and analyzes captured traffic using TrafficQL queries and detailed request-response views.
User manages device lists and device details, including firmware, wireless parameters, and task statuses.
User views containerized AI agents and their runtime status, resource utilization, and logs.
User configures system settings through a categorized sidebar and detailed settings panel.
User transitions between all views seamlessly via a unified top navigation bar with real-time status indicators.
validation_criteria: All UI components conform visually and interaction-wise with provided high-fidelity Figma designs.
Codebase compiles successfully with zero usage of unwraps, leveraging proper error handling.
All major views support responsive layouts, theming with light color schemes, and consistent UI elements (buttons, badges, tabs, cards).
Tasks across Kanban, asset management, vulnerability management, traffic monitoring, devices, and container monitoring operate correctly and reflect real-time data updates.
AI agent integrations correctly schedule, execute, and report results through the platform interfaces.
Sandbox environment securely isolates operations with VNC streaming and operational logging.
Performance metrics for task scheduling, traffic analysis, and scanning meet predefined benchmarks.
Security and multi-tenant isolation policies are implemented and verified via penetration testing.
Complete and clear documentation of architecture, UI/UX design, task breakdown, risk mitigation, and agent development guides are available.
Parallel development by multiple agents progresses without integration conflicts supported by clear task dependencies and code quality standards.
